sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Describes a common comma-separated format, optional first-row header, equal field counts, quoted fields and doubled quote escaping; expressly informational and not a universal CSV standard. Other implementations may vary.

sources.title: SQLite Transaction
sources.released_version_or_commit: Official rolling documentation; page does not state a single SQLite library release
sources.locator: Sections 2.1-2.3 and 3, including DEFERRED default, SQLITE_BUSY, and error response
sources.access_utc: 2026-10-12T02:38:50Z–2026-10-12T02:42:13Z (bounded batch window; exact page time unavailable)
sources.observed_operation: Read official transaction semantics, concurrency limits, busy behavior and automatic rollback caveats.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Only one simultaneous writer; default transaction is DEFERRED. COMMIT may return SQLITE_BUSY while leaving a transaction active. Disk-full, I/O, interrupt and memory failures may undo only a statement or the full transaction; documentation suggests explicit rollback for consistent state.
sources.applicability: Design explicit begin/commit/rollback and state checks; model busy retry and storage failures before declaring atomic apply.
